title: Chapter 96 Note 1 Scope and Exclusions
text: This Chapter covers miscellaneous manufactured articles. This Chapter does not cover: (a) Pencils for cosmetic or toilet uses; (b) Articles of Chapter 66 (for example, parts of umbrellas); (c) Imitation jewellery; (d) Parts of general use, as defined in Note 2 to Section XV, of base metal, or similar goods of plastics.

title: Chapter 96 Note 2 Carving Materials
text: In heading 9602 the expression 'vegetable or mineral carving material' means: (a) Hard seeds, pips, hulls and nuts and similar vegetable materials of a kind used for carving; (b) Amber, meerschaum, agglomerated amber and agglomerated meerschaum, jet and mineral substitutes for jet.

title: Worked ivory, bone, tortoiseshell, horn, antlers, coral, mother-of-pearl and other animal carving material, and articles of these materials
text: Heading 9601 covers worked ivory, bone, tortoiseshell, horn, antlers, coral, mother-of-pearl and other animal carving material, and articles of these materials.

title: Brooms, brushes (including brushes constituting parts of machines, appliances or vehicles), hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers, not motorised, mops and feather dusters
text: Heading 9603 covers brooms, brushes, paint pads and rollers, squeegees.

title: Ball point pens; felt tipped and other porous-tipped pens and markers; fountain pens, stylograph pens and other pens; duplicating stylos; propelling or sliding pencils; pen-holders, pencil-holders and similar holders; parts (including caps and clips) of the foregoing articles, other than those of heading 9609
text: Heading 9608 covers ball point pens, felt tipped and other porous-tipped pens and markers, fountain pens, stylograph pens and other pens, propelling pencils, and parts thereof.

title: Cigarette lighters and other lighters, whether or not mechanical or electrical, and parts thereof other than flints and wicks
text: Heading 9613 covers cigarette lighters and other lighters, whether or not mechanical or electrical, and parts thereof.

title: Vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels, complete with cases; parts thereof other than glass inners
text: Heading 9617 covers vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels, complete with cases; parts thereof other than glass inners. This heading applies to vacuum flasks having an inner flask (metal or glass) and an outer protective casing or body (such as moulded plastic, stainless steel, or other metal). Classification applies by virtue of the heading naming the article specifically, overriding general material headings under GRI 1 and GRI 3(a). Subheadings: 9617 00 11 (Vacuum flasks having capacity not exceeding 0.75 litre), 9617 00 12 (Vacuum flasks exceeding 0.75 litre).

title: Monopods, bipods, tripods and similar articles
text: Heading 9620 covers monopods, bipods, tripods and similar support articles regardless of material.
